lines.zh: 我退着走，法杖拖在地上。
lines.en: I walk backward, staff dragging on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的袍角扫过一地的骨。
lines.en: My robe hem sweeps across scattered bones.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边念着句子。
lines.en: I mutter a phrase with every step.

lines.zh: 法杖点地，响一下走一步。
lines.en: The staff taps the ground; one step per tap.
I do not approach; I only back away.

lines.zh: 我的脚步轻得几乎没有声。
lines.en: My footsteps are nearly soundless.

lines.zh: 我绕着一堆骨头转半圈。
lines.en: I walk half a circle around a bone pile.

lines.zh: 我在找能站住脚的高处。
lines.en: I am looking for high ground to stand on.

lines.zh: 每一步我都先看你的手。
lines.en: Before each step I check your hands.

lines.zh: 我的杖头在地上画出痕。
lines.en: The staff's head scores the ground.

lines.zh: 我走到你够不到的地方。
lines.en: I move to where you cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子退到石柱后。
lines.en: I shuffle back behind a stone pillar.
I count the bones one by one.
I polish the staff's tip with my sleeve.
I arrange the bones into a ring.
I murmur an old incantation.

lines.zh: 我听着地下有没有回应。
lines.en: I listen for an answer from underground.

lines.zh: 我的杖头一直亮着微光。
lines.en: The staff's head keeps a faint glow.

lines.zh: 我把断掉的指骨收进袋。
lines.en: I pocket a broken finger bone.
I stop counting at seventeen.

lines.zh: 我在等骨头自己动起来。
lines.en: I wait for the bones to move on their own.
I stand very straight and very still.
I watch you from behind a pillar.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.

lines.zh: 我数着你身上能用的部分。
lines.en: I am counting the usable parts on you.
I raise the staff, then lower it slowly.
I am measuring the line you would charge along.
Your bones will be mine eventually.
I tilt my head; the staff chimes faintly.
I fix my gaze on your ankle.
You are closer than I expected.

lines.zh: 我在你身上数出太多骨头。
lines.en: I count far too many bones on you.
I nearly lose my grip on the staff.
You broke my chant.
I retreat and recount the bones.
That blow collapses my shoulder.
My robe tears open in a line.
I cough up a mouthful of bone dust.
I lean on the pillar to steady myself.
You were one step faster than my reckoning.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在皮下面错位。
lines.en: My bones have shifted under the skin.
I grit my teeth and raise the staff again.
Food is not on my account.

lines.zh: 我要的是骨头，不是面包。
lines.en: I want bone, not bread.
You hold out meat; I only watch my staff.

lines.zh: 我这副身子早不进食了。
lines.en: This body stopped eating long ago.

lines.zh: 你的骨头比你的食物香。
lines.en: Your bones smell better than your food.
Feeding me only makes me remember you.
I am not hungry; I am short of bones.

lines.zh: 你把吃的放回去，别耽误。
lines.en: Put the food away; do not waste time.

lines.zh: 你的面包填不满我的骨圈。
lines.en: Your bread cannot fill my ring of bones.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢你还站着的骨头。
lines.en: I prefer your bones while you still stand.

lines.zh: 我的杖横过来挡了一下。
lines.en: I bring the staff across to block.
You charge; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我的骨头被你撞得移位。
lines.en: The impact shifts my bones out of line.
My robe snags on your armor.
I push you off with an elbow.

lines.zh: 我撞到石壁上，咔嚓一声。
lines.en: I hit the wall with a crack.
You shove me back a foot.

lines.zh: 我的指骨擦过你的胸口。
lines.en: My finger bones brush your chest.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢近身，别贴过来。
lines.en: I dislike closeness; do not press in.
We break apart and both find footing.
Bones have no need of a mate.
I speak only with bones.
My old companion came apart long ago.

lines.zh: 我念咒时不需要谁在旁。
lines.en: I need no one beside me while I chant.

lines.zh: 没有人愿意嫁给唤骨者。
lines.en: Nobody would wed a bonescaller.
My betrothal stayed in the ground.
I have kept a set of bones for myself.

lines.zh: 夜里我只听见骨头在响。
lines.en: At night I hear only bones clatter.
I do not seek a mate; I seek materials.

lines.zh: 谁靠近我，最后都只剩骨。
lines.en: Whoever comes close ends as bone.
I lever a bone up with my staff's tip.
I bend; a string of joints pops.
That femur is mine now.
I stuff the bone into my robe.
I do not pick up what is too heavy.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的那节指骨。
lines.en: I pick up the finger bone you dropped.

lines.zh: 我把它放进腰间的袋子。
lines.en: I drop it into the pouch at my waist.
I take only one piece at a time.
I take bones and leave the rest to insects.
Once I have it, I step back two paces.
Your bones are calling to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起杖，指向你的胸口。
lines.en: I lift my staff and point it at your chest.
You have come close; just as I wanted.

lines.zh: 我在你身上数到两百块。
lines.en: I count two hundred bones on you.

lines.zh: 我念出你名字里的第一个音。
lines.en: I speak the first sound of your name.
The staff's head brightens.
You stepped into my ring of bones.
I have found tonight's material.
The way you stand suits me.
I step back only to see you better.

lines.zh: 你要么走开，要么留下骨头。
lines.en: Either walk away or leave your bones.
I have already begun the chant.
My staff's tip tracks you.
Your breath quickens, so the chant comes easy.

lines.zh: 我停下手，你比上一批好用。
lines.en: I stop. You will do better than the last batch.
One step from you, two from me.
I keep measuring this distance.
The staff's light lines up with your knee.
You want to close in; I will not allow it.

lines.zh: 我靠着石柱，你绕不过来。
lines.en: I keep the pillar at my back; you cannot circle.
I wait for the moment you raise your hand.
You cannot hit me; I keep moving.

lines.zh: 我记下你每一步的落点。
lines.en: I mark where each of your steps lands.
One step closer and I release the spell.
I stand with my retreat behind me.
My staff trembles faintly.

lines.zh: 你手上的盾挡不住这个。
lines.en: That shield will not stop this.
I watch your feet from the corner of my eye.
No hurry; the spell is ready.

lines.zh: 我退到墓碑后，你看不见我。
lines.en: I back behind a gravestone where you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 你的脚步进了我画的那一圈。
lines.en: Your steps have entered the circle I drew.

lines.zh: 我抬杖，土里的东西动了。
lines.en: I lift my staff, and something in the soil stirs.
You charge, and I give up half a step first.
The staff's head cracks your collarbone.
I sweep the staff and push your sword aside.
I fling a handful of bone dust in your face.
I jab your ribs with the staff's butt.
You press too close; I have to strike.

lines.zh: 我的杖打断了你的一击。
lines.en: My staff breaks your swing.
I set my teeth and bring the staff down.

lines.zh: 我的袖子里掉出几块骨。
lines.en: A few bones fall from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我把整条胳膊都甩了出去。
lines.en: I throw my whole arm behind the swing.
You fall back; I pull away at once.
I strike your wrist, not your head.
The staff slides off your armor.
After the blow I retreat into my bone ring.
My bones rattle inside my robe.

lines.zh: 杖身横过来，卡住你的剑。
lines.en: I turn the staff sideways and catch your blade.

lines.zh: 我用杖尾的骨钉扎你的膝。
lines.en: The bone spike on my staff bites your knee.
I stand in the middle of a ring of bones.
My staff lights first, then me.
I rise straight up out of grave soil.
The bone ring begins to turn by itself.
I finish the last sound of the chant.

lines.zh: 我从坍塌的祭坛下走出。
lines.en: I walk out from under a collapsed altar.
My hand comes out of a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 我先听见自己的骨头响。
lines.en: I hear my own bones first.
The little bone piles around me stir.
I plant the staff in the soil to steady myself.

lines.zh: 这里的骨头够我用很久。
lines.en: There are bones enough here for ages.
My robe still carries dirt.

lines.zh: 我来的时候没有脚步声。
lines.en: I arrived without a footstep.
The bones quiet down; I stand.

lines.zh: 火烧起来，我的召骨咒断了。
lines.en: The fire catches and my summoning chant breaks.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，骨圈散了一半。
lines.en: I fall and half my bone ring scatters.
The water keeps me from voicing the words.
The blast knocks the staff out of my hand.
An arrow pins my staff and throws it off.

lines.zh: 魔力枯竭，我召唤不出东西。
lines.en: My magic drains and nothing answers my call.
Hunger stopped meaning anything to me.

lines.zh: 雷把我脚下的骨圈烧黑了。
lines.en: Lightning scorches the bone ring at my feet.
I fall into the dark, staff still glowing.
